ViGALT_ablation.alt_text: A white-painted bed frame has a peaked roof-shaped frame, four corner posts, and raised guard panels made of vertical slats along the sides and foot end. The frame has a solid back panel behind the sleeping surface and an opening at the front. The low-set sleeping surface contains a white mattress with a lightly quilted cover.
